colors.notes: Accent is reserved for CTAs and key highlights only.

logo.usage: Primary logo on light backgrounds only; reversed logo on dark. Never stretched, recolored, or placed over busy imagery without a scrim.
logo.min_clear_space: Equal to the height of the logomark on all sides

required_elements: Event name and dates in the hero
Primary registration CTA above the fold
tone: Professional, energetic, benefit-led. No exclamation-mark stacking, no unverifiable superlatives.
